ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of Federal Funding Freezes
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of the Trump administration's funding freezes on various projects and programs, including the Gateway Tunnel Project and childcare services in Minnesota.
questions: What is the reasoning behind the Trump administration's funding freezes?
How have these funding freezes affected the Gateway Tunnel Project and childcare services in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: I believe this story is important because it could reveal a larger pattern of the Trump administration's funding decisions and their impact on various projects and programs. By investigating this story, we could uncover potential wrongdoing and hold those in power accountable.
